reason: Cafés and salons already DM me on Instagram and I'm happy doing a reel for free food or a haircut, so I don't see why I'd open another app. I'd probably scroll past this.
objection: I already get DMs; I don't need an app to find offers. And I doubt many Bengaluru cafés will actually pay a written fee when they can get creators like me for barter.
would_change_my_mind: A friend showing me a real paid invite they got through Mitra from a place near me, with the fee actually paid.
